verdict.rationale: Appwrite's Functions docs state that functions can be triggered by server events, as well as HTTP requests, SDK methods, webhooks and schedules. That is the core of event-driven execution. The evidence does not specifically list database or auth events among those triggers, and there is no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of database and auth event types (e.g. row create/update, user create/session events) as function triggers, event configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
